资产角色：
<Picture 1>
国风动漫少女，深棕色发髻点缀红梅与蝶形发饰，身穿白金红相间的抹胸上衣与飘逸薄纱灯笼裤，周身环绕金红流光与炽炎花瓣特效。
<Picture 2>
硬派白发战将，身穿暗红色皮革长款风衣、黑色内衬与战术皮裤，手持重剑与双枪，周身散发冷冽红黑魔力气浪。

一个低机位推近镜头框住
<Picture 1>
与
<Picture 2>
在废墟长廊两端对峙。
<Picture 1>
率先启动超音速贴地冲刺，足尖踏出金红烈焰莲华，甩出赤红绫缎如游龙贯空；
the camera cuts to
侧面跟摇特写，
<Picture 2>
拔出重剑横向重劈，刀锋与炽炎绫缎剧烈碰撞，火星与雷光四向迸射，气浪撕裂地面石板。
the shot transitions to
俯冲环绕镜头，
<Picture 1>
借力凌空翻腾，双掌结印召唤暴雨般金红火蝶与符文剑气垂直轰炸；
<Picture 2>
单手举剑格挡，魔力红光护盾展开，随即甩动红风衣滑步侧移，拔枪极速连射，火舌与剑气在半空接连引爆。
the camera dynamically follows
贴地高速滑移，
<Picture 1>
在弹雨残影中多维瞬闪，瞬身突进至
<Picture 2>
身前旋身横扫，赤焰气刃斩开风衣下摆；
the shot changes to
极速下坠定点特写，
<Picture 2>
反手抽刀上挑震开攻击，
<Picture 1>
空中旋身单手撑地滑退数米，
<Picture 1>
与
<Picture 2>
同时稳住身形横刃相对，周身烈火与魔能疯狂暴涨，在最强杀意临界点定格。
overall_soundscape: Explosive shockwaves crack the stone ground as steel clashes with fiery energy ribbons. Gunfire roars in rapid bursts followed by the sizzling hum of burning petals and swirling demonic aura.non_diegetic_music: High-octane heavy metal hybrid with aggressive electric guitar riffs, pounding industrial drums, and intense symphonic brass, cutting off sharply on the final clash.

nodes.title: Example guide · official LBH two-pass
widgets_values:
# Spark-H3 + official LBH two-pass LightX2V workflow

- This follows the repository h3_lbh path, not h3_selflift.
- LightX2V LoRA: minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfy.safetensors.
- Pass 1: 0.2 MP canvas; simple 8-point schedule split after 4 model evaluations.
- The first sampler's denoised_output is split into video/audio latents. Only video is lifted by MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D; audio is passed through unchanged.
- Target: 0.98 MP (1344x768 for 16:9). Pass 2 re-noises with the same fixed seed and uses video sigmas 0.9035, 0.6316, 0.3158, 0.0 (3 evaluations).
- Spark patches only the pass-2 high-resolution model: 3 steps, no warmup, topk_ratio=0.1, dense_layers=0, q_reuse_k.
- Requires LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler and the v1 FP16 upscaler in ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/.
- Replace the example input image(s) and prompt before running.
